findings.claim: TEL 10-K 列出 Transportation Solutions 主要對手為 Yazaki、Aptiv、Sumitomo、Sensata、Honeywell、Molex、Amphenol；公司自述已經歷且預期持續面臨價格下行壓力
findings.excerpt: The Transportation Solutions segment’s major competitors include Yazaki, Aptiv, Sumitomo, Sensata, Honeywell, Molex, and Amphenol.

findings.claim: TEL 風險因子自述競爭已經且可能再損及價格、毛利與市占，且無法保證不會有新競爭者進入
findings.excerpt: We cannot provide assurance that additional competitors will not enter our markets or that we will be able to compete successfully against existing or new competitors. Increased competition has and may in the future result in price reductions, reduced margins, or loss of market share

competitive_share_entrants.note: 兩次搜尋未找到 2026 年 TEL 專屬份額消長數據或具名新進入者；聚合站僅稱 Amphenol 有份額成長（Zacks/Nasdaq 比較文），未讀原文故不列 finding。

clues.claim: Nasdaq/Zacks 比較文稱 Amphenol 份額成長、盈餘上修較快，TE 表現穩定但終端市場較不均
clues.source: Nasdaq/Zacks: Amphenol vs. TE Connectivity: Which Connector Stock is Most Suitable?
